## Capability.name property

Stable, dotted capability name: `<app>.<resource>.<operation>`<!-- -->.

Examples (VISION.md §7.1): `calendar.events.create`<!-- -->, `reminders.tasks.create`<!-- -->, `finder.files.search`<!-- -->. Stable across regeneration so agents and recipes can reference it durably.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly name: string;
```
